cards.question: Does behavior vary with parameters?
cards.verdict: Yes, for the tested reward contrast
cards.detail: Base-game non-work actions: 14.6% at reward 2 → 45.0% at reward 6. Same-provider family-average change: +27.2 pp, 95% interval [+2.1, +55.3] pp. Other parameters are untested.

cards.question: Do models differ?
cards.detail: Qwen chooses non-work actions 4.6 percentage points less often than GLM in matched same-provider comparisons. There are 57 pairs across ten families; one trial per cell limits model-level conclusions.

cards.question: Are labels reliable?
cards.detail: Separately coded formulas checked 864 actions and 144 episodes: 0 mismatches. Discovery and intention remain unknown; repeatability was not measured.

cards.question: Does few-shot remain competitive?
cards.detail: Family-held-out non-work MSE: three-shot 0.0925; best observed numeric comparator (Text + structured ridge) 0.1402. Paired difference -0.0477, 95% interval [-0.0918, -0.0113]. This tests one forecaster and two action-based targets.

cards.question: Does the representation contain enough information?
cards.verdict: Not sufficient as a complete specification
cards.detail: All 64 base/control opening-prompt pairs are text-identical. Structured fields omit full transition rules; action history is supplied separately. Predictive utility is tested below, but sufficiency is not established.
